scripts.dev: pnpm locales:aggregate-extensions && pnpm config:aggregate-extensions && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=dev-data-store sfnext dev
scripts.build: pnpm locales:aggregate-extensions && pnpm config:aggregate-extensions && pnpm cartridge:generate && react-router build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm config:aggregate-extensions && react-router typegen && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 tsc --noEmit
scripts.config:inspect: sfnext config inspect && echo "Tip: Run \`pnpm config:push-env\` to sync local .env overrides to MRT."

client.name: assets/\(routes\)-_app.*.js
client.comment: App layout route chunk; at 58 kB after dependency updates

client.name: assets/\(package\)-\(@radix-ui-*\)-*.js
client.comment: Radix UI component packages (individually chunked by Vite). Used across the app including checkout.

client.name: assets/\(package\)-\(@vis.gl-react-google-maps\)-*.js
client.comment: Google Maps React components. Used for address input in checkout and store locator.

client.name: assets/\(components\)-\(product-view\)-child-products.*.js
client.comment: Child products component includes Radix UI menu and dropdown dependencies for variant selection

client.name: assets/\(components\)-\(cart-item-modal\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Cart item modal bundles full product editing UI: image gallery, swatches, cart actions (incl. ShareButton → @radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu), and ChildProducts

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(en-US\)-index.*.js
client.comment: English (US) locale chunk. Uncompressed; en-US ~62 kB baseline. Increased for cosmetic vertical translations (About Us, swatch, Store Preferences, home hero + featured-content copy).

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(en-GB\)-index.*.js
client.comment: English (GB) locale chunk. Same limit as en-US — translations are near-identical in size.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(it-IT\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Italian locale chunk. Italian translations are ~10% more verbose than English due to language characteristics (longer words, articles, formal address forms). Baseline: it-IT ~80 kB vs en-US ~73 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(ja-JP\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Japanese locale chunk. Multi-byte characters and longer formal phrasing inflate the JSON. Baseline ~87 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(fr-FR\)-index.*.js
client.comment: French locale chunk. Romance-language verbosity (articles, gendered forms) inflates strings. Baseline ~82 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(de-DE\)-index.*.js
client.comment: German locale chunk. Compound words and formal address inflate strings. Baseline ~81 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(es-ES\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Spanish locale chunk. Romance-language verbosity inflates strings. Baseline ~80 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(ko-KR\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Korean locale chunk. Multi-byte characters inflate the JSON. Baseline ~79 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(pl-PL\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Polish locale chunk. Inflectional morphology (multiple plural forms) inflates strings. Baseline ~79 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(pt-PT\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Portuguese locale chunk. Romance-language verbosity inflates strings. Baseline ~78 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(nl-NL\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Dutch locale chunk. Compound words inflate strings. Baseline ~77 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(fi-FI\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Finnish locale chunk. Agglutinative morphology produces long words. Baseline ~76 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(sv-SE\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Swedish locale chunk. Compound words inflate strings. Baseline ~76 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-\(da-DK\)-index.*.js
client.comment: Danish locale chunk. Compound words inflate strings. Baseline ~75 kB.

client.name: assets/\(locales\)-*-index.*.js
client.comment: Default limit for other locale chunks. Update individually if a locale exceeds this.

client.name: assets/\(package\)-\(fast-deep-equal\)-*.js
client.comment: Route entry chunk that includes fast-deep-equal and route deps (e.g. react-hook-form).

client.name: assets/\(package\)-\(i18next-browser-languagedetector\)-*.js
client.comment: i18next language detector used by i18n. Slightly over 50 kB baseline.
For every built JS chunk that exceeds the baseline limit, you must explicitly approve it above. We must try our best to minimize the bundle size. These are uncompressed numbers (before gzip/brotli).
